learned_entries.answer_en:
🔬 **Probable Problems & Disease Diagnosis for Grapes:**

**Probable Diseases & Problem Indicators:**
• **Black Rot (Guignardia bidwellii):** Small circular reddish-brown leaf spots; shriveled, mummified black berries.
  *Causes & Risk Trigger:* Rain splash spreading spores from mummified berries left on vines.
  *Recommended Action:* Remove old mummies during winter pruning; spray mancozeb/triazoles early.
• **Esca (Black Measles):** Tiger-stripe leaf chlorosis and dark spotting on berries.
  *Causes & Risk Trigger:* Fungal complex infecting pruning wounds in woody trunks.
  *Recommended Action:* Sanitize pruning shears, treat trunk wounds with protective paste.
• **Leaf Blight (Isariopsis clavispora):** Irregular dark brown patches on mature foliage.
  *Causes & Risk Trigger:* Dense unpruned canopy and stagnant air.
  *Recommended Action:* Leaf-pulling around grape clusters to enhance air circulation.

🌡️ **Current Weather Context (31.0°C, 63.0% RH):** Elevated humidity (63.0%) creates a favorable microclimate for fungal spore germination and foliar infections. Ensure adequate canopy airflow.

**Key Protective Measures:**
• Maintain trellis canopy management for optimal airflow.
• Regulate deficit irrigation during veraison to enhance sugar accumulation.

query_templates: What about my rice field any precautions?

learned_entries.answer_en:
🌾 **Key Precautions & Protection Guidelines for Rice:**

1. Maintain controlled standing water (2-5 cm); drain excess flood water during storm surges.
2. Avoid excessive chemical nitrogen application during cloudy and humid periods.
3. Scout weekly for stem borer and blast lesions during panicle initiation.

learned_entries.answer_en:
🔬 **Probable Problems & Disease Diagnosis for Wheat:**

**Probable Diseases & Problem Indicators:**
• **Yellow / Stripe Rust:** Yellow pustules arranged in linear stripes on leaf blades.
  *Causes & Risk Trigger:* Prolonged cool moist weather and wind-borne spores.
  *Recommended Action:* Plant resistant cultivars, monitor early morning dew periods, apply triazole fungicides if risk escalates.
• **Terminal Heat Stress:** Premature leaf senescence, shriveled grains, and forced maturity.
  *Causes & Risk Trigger:* Late sowing and sudden temperature spikes.
  *Recommended Action:* Ensure light irrigation to reduce canopy temperature; apply potassium nitrate spray.

**Key Protective Measures:**
• Do not over-irrigate during flowering to prevent root lodging and rust susceptibility.
• Ensure balanced fertilization with adequate phosphorus and potassium.

learned_entries.answer_en:
🔬 **Probable Problems & Disease Diagnosis for Tomato:**

**Probable Diseases & Problem Indicators:**
• **Early Blight (Alternaria solani):** Concentric rings ('target board' pattern) on older lower leaves.
  *Causes & Risk Trigger:* Foliar wetness from dew or rain followed by warm sunshine.
  *Recommended Action:* Stake plants, mulch to prevent soil splashing, remove lower diseased leaves.
• **Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans):** Water-soaked irregular lesions with white mold on leaf undersides.
  *Causes & Risk Trigger:* Continuous leaf wetness and cool humid microclimates.
  *Recommended Action:* Apply preventive copper/mancozeb sprays before continuous rain spells; avoid overhead watering.
• **Bacterial Spot (Xanthomonas):** Small, dark, water-soaked circular spots with yellow halos.
  *Causes & Risk Trigger:* Bacterial pathogen spread by wind-driven rain and infected seeds.
  *Recommended Action:* Use certified seed, apply copper-bactericide sprays, avoid sprinkler irrigation.

**Key Protective Measures:**
• Use drip irrigation to keep foliage dry and minimize fungal spore germination.
• Stake and prune indeterminate varieties to optimize airflow and sunlight penetration.

query_templates: When to spray pesticide or fungicide?
कीटनाशक का छिड़काव कब करना चाहिए?
کیڑے مار اور فنگس کش دوا کا اسپرے کب کریں؟
learned_entries.answer_en:
🚿 **Safe Spraying Guidelines for Pesticides & Fungicides:**

1) **Optimal Timing:** Spray during calm morning or late afternoon hours (wind speed < 12 km/h).
2) **Rain Check:** Postpone spraying if rain is forecast within 4-6 hours.
3) **Avoid Peak Heat:** Never spray in scorching afternoon heat (>32°C) to prevent leaf scorching.
4) **Protective Gear:** Always maintain proper dilution and wear protective gear.

query_templates: How to use fertilizer properly?
खाद और उर्वरक का सही उपयोग कैसे करें?
کھاد اور یوریا کا صحیح استعمال کیسے کریں؟
learned_entries.answer_en:
🌱 **General Balanced Fertilizer Rules:**
1) Apply full Phosphorus (DAP) & Potash as basal dose at sowing.
2) Split Nitrogen (Urea) into 2-3 top-dressings during active growth stages.
3) Avoid applying urea right before rain or in standing flood water.
4) Supplement with micronutrients (Zinc, Boron) for strong root and grain health.

query_templates: धान में कौन सी बीमारी लगती है?
چاول میں کون سی بیماریاں لگتی ہیں؟
learned_entries.answer_hi:
🔬 **धान / चावल (Rice) की संभावित समस्याएं, रोग लक्षण एवं रोकथाम:**

**संभावित रोग, समस्याएं एवं लक्षण:**
• **जीवाणु झुलसा (Bacterial Leaf Blight):** पत्तियों के किनारों से सूखना और पीली-सफेद धारियां बनना।
  *बचाव:* अत्यधिक यूरिया न डालें, खेत से पानी निकालें और कॉपर फफूंदनाशक का छिड़काव करें।
• **धान का ब्लास्ट रोग (Rice Blast):** पत्तियों पर आंख या नाव के आकार के भूरे-सफेद धब्बे।
  *बचाव:* पौधों में पर्याप्त दूरी रखें और ट्राइसायक्लाजोल या जैव कवकनाशी का छिड़काव करें।

**सुरक्षात्मक सावधानियां:**
• खेत में 2-5 सेमी नियंत्रित जल स्तर बनाए रखें; तेज बारिश के समय जल निकासी करें।
• बादल छाए रहने और अधिक नमी के समय अतिरिक्त यूरिया (नाइट्रोजन) का उपयोग न करें।

query_templates: टमाटर की फसल में क्या सावधानी बरतें?
learned_entries.answer_hi:
🌾 **टमाटर (Tomato) की फसल के लिए मुख्य सावधानियां:**

1. पत्तियों को गीला होने से बचाने के लिए ड्रिप सिंचाई (टपक सिंचाई) का उपयोग करें।
2. अगेती व पछेती झुलसा (Blight) से बचाव हेतु पौधों के बीच हवा का प्रवाह बनाए रखें।
3. पौधों को सहारा (Staking) दें ताकि फल और पत्तियां जमीन की नमी के संपर्क में न आएं।
4. अधिक नमी होने पर कॉपर ऑक्सीक्लोराइड या मैंकोजेब का सुरक्षात्मक छिड़काव करें।
